# Question 1

```{r}
tribble( ~x,    ~y,    ~w,    ~z,
              210,   300,   220,   180,
              102,   100,   119,   187,
              176,   175,   188,   173,
              87,    95,   91,     94,
              202,   210,  234,    218,
              110,   122,  131,    128,
) -> dt
```

#A) 

```{r}
map(dt, mean)
```
#B)
```{r}
map(dt,sd)
```
#C)
```{r}
map(dt, sqrt)
```
#D) 

```{r}
summary(dt)
```
